caption:
In 2016, electric vehicles barely existed on India's roads. In June 2026, they crossed 12% of every new vehicle sold.

EV retail sales hit 306,220 units in June 2026, pushing penetration past 12% for the first time - up 41x from just 50,000 units sold in 2016.

Two-wheelers are leading the shift - over half of every EV sold is a scooter or a bike, not a car. Nearly 400 EV startups are now building everything from charging networks to batteries.

The government's target is 30% EV penetration by 2030. The gap is closing fast, but cars and trucks still lag far behind two-wheelers.

This isn't a finished transition. It's a curve that's bending faster every year.

Sources: IBEF, Prakati, SMEV/NITI Aayog data (2026)
